ITEM 1 | Dark red-purple leafy greens with ruffled edges and reddish-brown veining, forming the largest mass on the left and upper portion of the plate, covering roughly 35% of the plate, with some leaves glossy and slightly wilted, piled a few cm high | 90
ITEM 2 | Bright green curly-edged leafy greens interspersed among the purple leaves, with pale green midribs and a few small red flecks, spread across the center and lower-left, covering roughly 15% of the plate, low pile about 1 cm high, slightly glossy with dressing | 40
ITEM 3 | Bright green broccoli florets with tight dark green buds and short pale stems, clustered on the right side of the plate, covering roughly 20% of the plate, piled about 2-3 cm high, matte and moist-looking, with a few loose small florets scattered near the edge | 75
ITEM 4 | Dark glossy green-brown wilted leaf pieces and a small stem fragment at the lower center, covering roughly 5% of the plate, flat and limp, lightly sheened | 15
